questions.q: Find the radius of convergence of $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{x^n}{n}$.
questions.answer: Ratio test: $\left|\frac{x^{n+1}/(n+1)}{x^n/n}\right| \to |x|$. Converges for $|x|<1$: radius of convergence $R=1$.

questions.q: Find the radius of convergence of $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{x^n}{n!}$.
questions.answer: Ratio test: $\left|\frac{x^{n+1}n!}{(n+1)!x^n}\right| = \frac{|x|}{n+1} \to 0$ for every $x$: radius of convergence $R=\infty$.

questions.q: Find the first three nonzero terms of the Maclaurin series for $f(x) = e^x$, using $f^{(n)}(0) = 1$ for all $n$.
Find the third-degree Taylor polynomial for $f(x) = \cos x$ centered at $x = 0$.
